sources.snippet: OpenArm is an open-source humanoid robot arm designed for AI and robotics research in human-centered environments. Its modular hardware and accessible software make it a flexible platform for teleoperation, imitation learning, and real-world data collection. Our goal is to advance physical intelligence by enabling robots that operate safely and effectively alongside people — in homes ...
